headline: RTX (RTX) Stock May Be Below Fair Value On Cash Flow Yet Full On Earnings
summary: RTX stock has moved sharply higher over the past few years, yet current checks suggest it now trades close to what a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) based intrinsic value estimate and market multiples would consider a fair price rather than an obvious bargain. The share price has returned 181.5% over 5 years, which means anyone looking at RTX today is evaluating a company that has already seen a strong re rating.
